name: Electric Motorcycle
description: A two- or three-wheeler with an electric motor that can exceed 28 mph on level ground and is road-legal under the licensing, registration and insurance rules for motorcycles.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and an electric motor capable of more than 28 mph on level ground
Ridden on public roads under the same licensing, registration and insurance requirements as a motorcycle
Can't be ridden on a bike path, bike lane or any other path or roadway designated for bicycles
Not an electric bicycle, whose motor is capped at 750 W and whose assistance stops by 28 mph
restrictions.citation: Hawaii Revised Statutes §291C-1, as amended by HB 2021 (2026)

restrictions.rule: The definition applies only to the bicycle-facility ban; otherwise it is a motorcycle, or a motor-driven cycle at 5 horsepower (3,750 W) or less
One over 750 W that isn't registered for the road is a high-speed electric device, barred from every public road and area
